sql: CLUSTER ( v1 , v1 ) t1 USING v1
DECLARE t1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 1 ) ) ) ) ) ) )
DECLARE t1 CURSOR WITH FOR SELECT 1
DECLARE t1 ASENSITIVE CURSOR FOR SELECT 1
DECLARE t1 SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT 1
DECLARE t1 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 1 )
DECLARE t1 BINARY ASENSITIVE NO SCROLL CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR SELECT 1
DECLARE t1 INSENSITIVE CURSOR FOR SELECT 1
DECLARE t1 CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR SELECT 1
DECLARE t1 CURSOR WITHOUT HOLD FOR SELECT 1
PREPARE t1 ( INT , INT ) AS SELECT 1
REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY t1 WITH NO DATA
REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW t1 WITH DATA
REINDEX ( v1 , v1 ) DATABASE CONCURRENTLY t1
REINDEX ( v1 , v1 ) INDEX CONCURRENTLY t1
VACUUM FULL FREEZE VERBOSE ANALYZE v1 , v1
